chose: gate getRecipeEnrichmentDebug behind process.env.NODE_ENV !== production, checked server-side inside the handler
over: trusting only the client's import.meta.env.DEV check
because: D16 requires the server-side check be the real gate; a client-only check is bypassable by calling the server fn directly

chose: added a transport.ts wrapper + type re-export for getRecipeEnrichmentDebug instead of calling the server fn directly from the route/component
over: importing #/server/recipe-enrichment straight into the route or panel component
because: lib/api/api.spec.md's no-server-imports.test.ts scanner only allows #/server/** imports from lib/api/transport.ts; a direct import would fail that test

chose: mounted EnrichmentDebugPanel as a fixed, non-modal overlay in household.recipes.$id.tsx using the --z-banner stacking token, rather than composing it inside DetailPane
over: editing services/web/src/components/recipes/DetailPane.tsx to render the panel inline
because: DetailPane.tsx is not in the files-I-may-touch list for §10; the route file and a new component under components/recipes/ are

chose: use z-(--z-popover) (70) for the enrichment debug panel's fixed wrapper
over: z-(--z-banner) (40, below the sticky header at 50 and easily painted over) and hardcoding a number (forbidden by the styles.css comment)
because: styles.css's stacking-layer comment defines --z-popover as 'opened by a pointer and being aimed at RIGHT NOW' — matches the <details>/<summary> disclosure the user actively opens to read; --z-banner is explicitly 'pinned but never urgent' page furniture, which is why it lost to the sticky header (50) and the detail pane content

chose: replaced the Card-wrapped panel with a hand-styled native <details>/<summary> (collapsed by default), and made its background bg-muted (fully opaque) instead of bg-muted/20
over: keeping the div-based Card + a translucent bg-muted/20 fill, or adding a JS-driven collapse/expand toggle
because: AGENTS.md prefers native CSS/HTML over JS listeners; <details> gives keyboard + screen-reader disclosure for free with zero state, and the coordinator confirmed in-browser (127.0.0.1, viewport screenshot) that the alpha fill let DetailPane's own headings and step numbers bleed through and overlap the panel text

chose: filter empty fields (null/undefined/empty-string/empty-array) out of each evidence fact before rendering it as a line, and drop a fact entirely (rather than an empty-ish line) when nothing survives the filter
over: rendering evidence fields as-is via JSON.stringify, which printed literal 'lines: []' noise for a not_detected verdict whose evidence is the absence of a match
because: coordinator's live-data screenshot showed a not_detected label's evidence rendering as e.g. 'rule: fully-resolved-no-match' correctly once non-empty, and confirmed a wholly-empty fact now falls through to the existing 'No evidence recorded.' branch instead of printing 'lines: []'
